nominee.longerDescription: HAPPY WW! This week I am nominating 1/4 planned wws. Okay, tbh last week was planned too but I wasn't sure about the exact order and picks. Anyhow, let me introduce you to Ash Santos! Recently I have been on a tv show run since I have a discovered SkyShowTime and they have quite the fine selection of tv shows. Many of them are American tv shows maybe thats why I found so many I like. I have found Yellowjackets here and now I have a pick from Yellowstone's (remember that name :P) spin off, Marshals. She is playing a US marshal in the show and since its a spin off of Yellowstone and I only watched 1.5 episodes before deciding to first watch Yellowstone I don't know much more other than her being a tough lady who is not keen on the cowboy life. However her looks won her to be part of this week's ww and to win the first pick of the pre-selected wws so best believe I dig her a lot! Outside of the show I don't know much about her other than that she was married and just got a man not too long ago so I lowkey just arrived late but its obviously because she haven't met me :P Hype 9/10 Yeehaw 1000/10 Snippet of how I feel because of the show + her: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z1ZDVhOaa0s
